statement: Learning cannot make an ineligible insight eligible.
Preference data cannot change scientific certainty.
Preference data cannot alter safety severity.
Preference data cannot change authority class.
Critical safety bypasses cooldown.
Critical safety cannot be permanently muted.
Exact duplicates never generate a new active insight.
Contradictions are never suppressed as duplicates.
Material revisions preserve prior lineage.
Cooldown affects delivery only.
Adaptive ranking is bounded.
Adaptive ranking cannot cross hard priority tiers unless explicit policy permits it.
Dwell time and engagement volume cannot drive ranking.
Every suppression decision has a reason receipt.
Every delivered insight has a ranking receipt.
Every selected action has a policy receipt.
One insight has at most one primary action.
NO_ACTION is a valid outcome.
Reserved actions never auto-execute.
Learning is captured only from observable user response or completed state change.
